annotations.title: Market reading of a finwire ranking: business account cost, business loan fee, credit card interest, free first loan (finwire indices)

description: Use for what a business account costs without meeting the conditions, the arrangement fee of a business loan, how high credit card interest is compared with the legal maximum, and up to what amount a first loan from a lending company costs 0 PLN. For one offer, send the user to the ranking page. For cash loans and mortgages, use get_bank_rates. Daily finwire reading from offers of banks and lenders in partner networks (System Partnerski, ComperiaLead), with history and the change vs 30 days earlier. product: business-account = finwire_business_account_cost (median monthly fee for a business account and its card when the company does not meet the fee waiver condition; offers at 0 PLN, welcome bonuses); business-loan = finwire_business_loan_fee (median arrangement fee in PLN that banks charge for a business loan in the ranking scenario; minimum company age; banks set the interest rate individually); credit-card = finwire_credit_card_rate (median interest rate on card purchases against the statutory maximum interest from the NBP reference rate; cards at the maximum, yearly fees, interest-free days); nonbank-loan = finwire_free_loan_limit (highest amount of a first loan at 0 PLN; only for new clients who repay on time; number of lenders). Aggregates of the market, not a quote for one person and not advice. For single offers, send the user to the ranking page.

history.description: Number of past daily readings in the summary, default 7.
